# MediaSurf Technologies — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org

# About
MediaSurf Technologies Inc. is a B2B digital technology partner based in Waterloo, Ontario, Canada.
We specialize in front-end web development (Vue.js, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS) and AI-powered learning platforms.

# B2B Services
- Front-End Engineering: Vue.js (Composition API), React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS — production-grade web applications. https://mediasurf.ca/contact
- Agency Sub-Contracting: White-label overflow development integrated into your workflow. https://mediasurf.ca/contact
- Custom Web Applications: SaaS dashboards, client portals, internal tools. https://mediasurf.ca/contact
- Performance & Modernization: Core Web Vitals, framework migrations, legacy app modernization. https://mediasurf.ca/contact

# Products
- LearnCraft Authoring Suite: AI course generator (GPT-4o) + live block-based editor. Generates lessons, quizzes, flashcards, branching scenarios. Exports SCORM/xAPI. https://learncraftedu.ca
- CreatorLoom: AI video course generator & authoring studio. Generates scripts, voiceovers, visuals, and animations — no filming required. https://creatorloom.mediasurf.ca
- PowerPoint AI Tool: Upload any PPT and convert slides to structured lessons, modules, and quizzes. https://learncraftedu.ca
- PitStop: Mobile mechanic marketplace connecting customers with certified mobile technicians. https://pitstopservices.ca

# Services
- Custom LMS Development: SCORM/xAPI-compliant platforms with AI integration, analytics, and SSO. https://mediasurf.ca/services/custom-lms-development
- Employee Onboarding & Corporate Training: Role-based learning pathways, AI-generated content, measurable outcomes. https://mediasurf.ca/services/employee-onboarding
